feed.title: Hugging Face — Trending Papers
feed.subtitle: Trending research papers from the Hugging Face community.

entry.title: Editable Visual Design
entry.content: A coding agent guided by a vision-language model generates editable layered designs by synthesizing isolated visual assets and iteratively refining native HTML/CSS layouts.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: Repo-To-Skill: Distilling GitHub Repositories Into AI4AI Skills
entry.content: DisCo is a research agent that distills operational knowledge into reusable skills, significantly improving autonomous ML research performance across benchmarks.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: SolarWM: Open Data and Scalable Training for Long-Horizon Video World Models
entry.content: SolarWM provides an open framework and unified training recipe for building interactive video world models across diverse data sources and generator backbones, enabling long-horizon real-time rollouts.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: H3-World: Turning Language Understanding into World Control
entry.content: We present H3-World, an efficient framework that turns the 33B MiniMax-H3 video generator into an interactive world model. Our key finding is that, as large video generators become more capable, language is emerging as a natural interface for control. MiniMax-H3, for example, already supports zero-shot control of character behavior and camera motion through natural-language instructions. Building on this, H3-World turns this coarse language interface into precise, temporally grounded world control, without introducing dedicated action modules. entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: CogEvol: Towards Efficient and Reliable Learning Environment Generation
entry.content: CogEvol is a family of models that generate structured learning artifacts in a single pass using supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with vision-language rewards, achieving high quality with far fewer parameters and lower cost.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: DreamX-Creator: Democratizing Native Audio-Video Generation at 2K Resolution
entry.content: A compact 7B native joint audio-video generator uses cross-modal attention, progressive joint training, reinforcement learning with multimodal feedback, and an autoregressive 2K refinement pipeline to produce synchronized high-resolution outputs.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: LightNav-0: Eliciting VLM Spatial Intelligence for Generalist Embodied Navigation
entry.content: LightNav-0 is a compact generalist navigation model that leverages a pretrained vision-language model’s spatial reasoning via unified pointing tokens and action tokenization to achieve state-of-the-art embodied navigation across diverse tasks and robots.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: ContextPilot: Teaching Agents for Proactive Context Management via Fine-grained RL
entry.content: ContextPilot improves long-horizon agent reasoning by expanding context-editing tools and using reinforcement learning with branch sampling to identify critical context decisions.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: Code as Worlds: Agentic Discovery of Executable World Representations for Physical Reasoning
entry.content: Code-as-World represents physical environments as executable code to enable quantitative reasoning and scalable supervision for vision-language models.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: Revisiting Local Context for Long-Horizon Streaming 3D Reconstruction
entry.content: ABot-Recon achieves stable long-horizon streaming 3D reconstruction by using only local temporal context and frame-independent predictions composed sequentially, reducing drift via a lightweight temporal refiner and composition-aware pose loss.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: JIT-Agent: Scaling Harness Intelligence via Just-in-Time Harness Evolution
entry.content: JIT-Agent is a trainable model that synthesizes adaptive agent harnesses for off-the-shelf LLMs, improving performance across diverse models and tasks.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: VoiceMem: Streaming Dual-Brain Memory for Real-Time Interaction
entry.content: VoiceMem introduces a dual-brain streaming memory architecture for speech language models that improves retrieval accuracy, emotional personalization, and real-time efficiency.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: WeMM-Embedding: WeChat Multi-Modal Embedding Technical Report
entry.content: WeMM-Embedding is a family of universal multimodal embedding models that align text, images, videos, and interleaved inputs in a shared space, achieving state-of-the-art retrieval and recommendation performance across public benchmarks and large-scale WeChat applications.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: Apodex 1.1: Scaling Agentic Intelligence for Complex Work
entry.content: Apodex 1.1 improves sustained, verifiable progress on complex real-world tasks by scaling executable environments and training agents to coordinate long-horizon work with state maintenance and recovery.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: Prime Agent: A Self-Improving RLM Harness
entry.content: Prime Agent is an open-source harness that uses recursive subagents, persistent computation, and agent-to-agent coordination to extend language models' long-horizon capabilities across coding and reasoning tasks.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: AutoResearch: Insight In, Hallucination Out
entry.content: AutoResearch is a two-stage autonomous system that grounds research ideas through integrated generation and evidence-based execution to improve experimental reliability and measurable outcomes.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: 4DAnyone: Create Anyone in 4D from a Casual Monocular Video
entry.content: 4DAnyone reconstructs 4D humans from monocular video by generating multiview-consistent videos and lifting them into 4D Gaussian Splatting, using reference and target context designs to overcome scaling bottlenecks.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: Zetta ζ: An Efficient Closed-Loop Embodied Harness for Self-Evolving Physical Intelligence
entry.content: Zetta is a closed-loop embodied harness that evolves runtime critics and recovery skills online to govern physical execution at action frequency, achieving high success on robot benchmarks with faster inference and scaling self-exploration.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: FreeToken: Efficient Edge-Native MoE Serving with Bandwidth-Adaptive Execution
entry.content: FreeToken is an edge-native Mixture-of-Experts serving system that dynamically maps computation and model state onto heterogeneous local hardware to run large open-weight models on personal machines.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: StateM: Reaching 95.3% Raw Accuracy, or a \$15 Frontier Run, on Terminal-Bench 2.1 via Harness Scaling
entry.content: StateM is a runtime system that improves long-horizon agent execution through durable states, recoverable runbooks, and enforceable procedural controls without altering model weights.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: BDH-CQ: In-Context Learning with Recurrent Latent Reasoning
entry.content: A 150M-parameter reasoning model using recurrent latent reasoning and in-context learning achieves a new cost-accuracy frontier on ARC-AGI-1.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: Securing the AI Agent: A Unified Framework for Multi-Layer Agent Red Teaming
entry.content: AI-Infra-Guard is an open-source framework that addresses AI infrastructure security through layered detection paradigms spanning infrastructure, protocol, agent behavior, and model layers.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: Unlimited OCR Works
entry.content: Unlimited OCR introduces Reference Sliding Window Attention to eliminate growing memory consumption during long-sequence OCR tasks, enabling efficient transcription of multiple pages in a single forward pass.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: Ultralytics YOLO26: Unified Real-Time End-to-End Vision Models
entry.content: YOLO26 addresses real-time vision challenges through a unified model family with NMS-free inference, improved training strategies, and multi-task capabilities spanning detection, segmentation, and pose estimation.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: PaddleOCR-VL-1.6: Expanding the Frontier of Document Parsing with Under-Optimized Region Refinement and Progressive Post-Training
entry.content: PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 enhances document parsing performance through targeted data optimization and progressive post-training techniques, achieving state-of-the-art results on OmniDocBench v1.6.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: COLLEAGUE.SKILL: Automated AI Skill Generation via Expert Knowledge Distillation
entry.content: Person-grounded AI skills are automatically distilled from heterogeneous traces into inspectable, correctable packages that capture both capabilities and behavioral patterns.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: SkillOpt: Executive Strategy for Self-Evolving Agent Skills
entry.content: SkillOpt introduces a systematic text-space optimizer for agent skills that trains skills as external agent state with stable updates and zero deployment inference overhead, achieving superior performance across multiple benchmarks and execution environments.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: SenseNova-U1: Unifying Multimodal Understanding and Generation with NEO-unify Architecture
entry.content: Unified vision-language models treat understanding and generation as integrated processes rather than separate tasks, demonstrating strong performance across multiple multimodal capabilities including image synthesis and action reasoning.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: ARIS: Autonomous Research via Adversarial Multi-Agent Collaboration
entry.content: ARIS is an open-source research harness that uses cross-model adversarial collaboration to ensure reliable long-term research outcomes through coordinated execution, orchestration, and assurance layers.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: HY-WU (Part I): An Extensible Functional Neural Memory Framework and An Instantiation in Text-Guided Image Editing
entry.content: Foundation models require adaptive architectures to handle evolving objectives and user needs, leading to the development of HY-WU, a memory-first framework that generates instance-specific weight updates through functional memory modules.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: EverMemOS: A Self-Organizing Memory Operating System for Structured Long-Horizon Reasoning
entry.content: EverMemOS presents a self-organizing memory system for large language models that processes dialogue streams into structured memory cells and scenes to enhance long-term interaction capabilities.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: AI-Trader: Benchmarking Autonomous Agents in Real-Time Financial Markets
entry.content: AI-Trader presents the first fully automated live benchmark for evaluating large language models in financial decision-making across multiple markets with autonomous information processing.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: MinerU2.5: A Decoupled Vision-Language Model for Efficient High-Resolution Document Parsing
entry.content: MinerU2.5, a 1.2B-parameter document parsing vision-language model, achieves state-of-the-art recognition accuracy with computational efficiency through a coarse-to-fine parsing strategy.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: Continuous Audio Language Models
entry.content: Audio Language Models (ALM) have emerged as the dominant paradigm for speech and music generation by representing audio as sequences of discrete tokens. Yet, unlike text tokens, which are invertible, audio tokens are extracted from lossy codecs with a limited bitrate. As a consequence, increasing audio quality requires generating more tokens, which imposes a trade-off between fidelity and computational cost. We address this issue by studying Continuous Audio Language Models (CALM). These models instantiate a large Transformer backbone that produces a contextual embedding at every timestep. entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: VibeVoice Technical Report
entry.content: VibeVoice synthesizes long-form multi-speaker speech using next-token diffusion and a highly efficient continuous speech tokenizer, achieving superior performance and fidelity.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: AgentScope 1.0: A Developer-Centric Framework for Building Agentic Applications
entry.content: AgentScope enhances agentic applications by providing flexible tool-based interactions, unified interfaces, and advanced infrastructure based on the ReAct paradigm, supporting efficient and safe development and deployment.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: Kronos: A Foundation Model for the Language of Financial Markets
entry.content: Kronos, a specialized pre-training framework for financial K-line data, outperforms existing models in forecasting and synthetic data generation through a unique tokenizer and autoregressive pre-training on a large dataset.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: PDFMathTranslate: Scientific Document Translation Preserving Layouts
entry.content: PDFMathTranslate enables layout-preserving scientific document translation using large language models and precise layout detection, offering improved precision, flexibility, and efficiency.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: SmolVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Affordable and Efficient Robotics
entry.content: SmolVLA is a compact, efficient vision-language-action model that achieves competitive performance at reduced computational costs and can be deployed on consumer-grade hardware.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: Faster Video Diffusion with Trainable Sparse Attention
entry.content: Trainable sparse attention (VSA) reduces computational cost in video diffusion transformers with minimal impact on performance, enabling efficient scaling of the models.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: Mem0: Building Production-Ready AI Agents with Scalable Long-Term Memory
entry.content: Mem0, a memory-centric architecture with graph-based memory, enhances long-term conversational coherence in LLMs by efficiently extracting, consolidating, and retrieving information, outperforming existing memory systems in terms of accuracy and computational efficiency.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: SmolDocling: An ultra-compact vision-language model for end-to-end multi-modal document conversion
entry.content: SmolDocling is a compact vision-language model that performs end-to-end document conversion with robust performance across various document types using 256M parameters and a new markup format.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: IndexTTS: An Industrial-Level Controllable and Efficient Zero-Shot Text-To-Speech System
entry.content: IndexTTS, an enhanced text-to-speech system combining XTTS and Tortoise models, offers improved naturalness, enhanced voice cloning, and controllable usage through hybrid character-pinyin modeling and optimized vector quantization.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: Zep: A Temporal Knowledge Graph Architecture for Agent Memory
entry.content: Zep, a memory layer service, outperforms MemGPT in the DMR benchmark and LongMemEval by excelling in dynamic knowledge integration and temporal reasoning, critical for enterprise use cases.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
entry.content: A multi-agent framework using large language models for stock trading simulates real-world trading firms, improving performance metrics like cumulative returns and Sharpe ratio.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: OmniFlatten: An End-to-end GPT Model for Seamless Voice Conversation
entry.content: A novel GPT-based model, OmniFlatten, enables real-time natural full-duplex spoken dialogue through a multi-stage post-training technique that integrates speech and text without altering the original model's architecture.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: Very Large-Scale Multi-Agent Simulation in AgentScope
entry.content: Enhancements to the AgentScope platform improve scalability, efficiency, and ease of use for large-scale multi-agent simulations through distributed mechanisms, flexible environments, and user-friendly tools.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: OpenDevin: An Open Platform for AI Software Developers as Generalist Agents
entry.content: OpenDevin is a platform for developing AI agents that interact with the world by writing code, using command lines, and browsing the web, with support for multiple agents and evaluation benchmarks.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: FunAudioLLM: Voice Understanding and Generation Foundation Models for Natural Interaction Between Humans and LLMs
entry.content: FunAudioLLM enhances voice interactions by integrating SenseVoice for multilingual speech recognition, emotion detection, and audio event detection with CosyVoice for natural speech generation across languages, timbres, and styles.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: A decoder-only foundation model for time-series forecasting
entry.content: A large language model adapted for time-series forecasting achieves near-optimal zero-shot performance on diverse datasets across different time scales and granularities.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
entry.content: PagedAttention algorithm and vLLM system enhance the throughput of large language models by efficiently managing memory and reducing waste in the key-value cache.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering
entry.content: A method using 3D Gaussians for scene representation and optimized rendering allows high-quality, real-time novel-view synthesis at 1080p resolution.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers

entry.title: HuggingFace's Transformers: State-of-the-art Natural Language Processing
entry.content: Transformers library provides state-of-the-art Transformer architectures and pretrained models for natural language processing tasks with a unified API and emphasis on extensibility and robust deployment.
entry.dc:creator: Hugging Face Trending Papers
